title: Yellow Yogurt British Lamb Scotch Egg
description: A kid-friendly British dish featuring lamb shoulder, tandoor spices, and a sweet yellow yogurt sauce, wrapped in a soft and bouncy scotch egg form. This dish is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground lamb, tandoor spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Divide the lamb mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a patty and place a hard-boiled egg in the center of each patty.
Wrap the lamb mixture around the egg to form a scotch egg shape.
Dip each scotch egg into the beaten eggs and then roll in breadcrumbs to coat.
Place the scotch eggs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the scotch eggs are baking, mix together the yellow yogurt and chopped onion in a small bowl.
Serve the scotch eggs with the yellow yogurt sauce for dipping.
